test_browser_cdp_input_validation: test the browser_cdp tool returns errors for missing, non-string, or non-dict method parameters
test_cdp_endpoint_resolution: test the browser_cdp tool handles empty, non-WebSocket, and missing websockets library endpoint errors
test_browser_cdp_browser_level_call: test the browser_cdp tool sends a browser-level CDP call and receives a successful response
test_browser_cdp_target_attach_call: test the browser_cdp tool attaches to a target then dispatches a CDP method on the session
test_browser_cdp_timeout_handling: test the browser_cdp tool enforces timeout clamping and returns errors for slow CDP methods
test_browser_cdp_registry_integration: test the browser_cdp tool is registered in the browser toolset and dispatchable through the registry
test_browser_cdp_check_fn_gate: test the browser_cdp tool check function gates availability based on CDP URL and browser requirements
